synthesis:draft.headline: TAS1 experienced a five‑minute RRP spike to 450.08 $/MWh at 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (interval ending 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z).
summary: One five‑minute dispatch interval in the window exceeded the project analysis threshold of 300.0 $/MWh: RRP = 450.08 $/MWh at 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (interval_end_utc 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z).
Dispatch TOTALDEMAND at that five‑minute interval: 1105.32 MW (dispatch TOTALDEMAND measure).
Operational (30‑minute) demand for the half‑hour ending 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z: 1147.0 MW; window maximum operational demand observed: 1408.0 MW (interval_end_utc 2026-08-06T09:00:00Z).
Net interconnector flow at the peak 5‑minute interval: 63.84 MW (net flow out of TAS1, export).
No AEMO market notice for TAS1 in the searched event window was returned by the document search; procedure and data‑model documents were retrieved (see citations).

numeric_claims.text: number of five‑minute intervals meeting the project threshold = 1
dispatch TOTALDEMAND at peak five‑minute interval = 1105.32 MW
operational demand for half‑hour ending 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z = 1147.0 MW
window maximum operational demand observed = 1408.0 MW
net interconnector flow at peak = 63.84 MW
MUSSELRO observed change in SCADA = 54.8 MW
LK_ECHO observed change in SCADA = -27.1 MW

possible_explanations.statement: A single high-priced offer clearing for the five‑minute dispatch ending 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z (2026-08-06 13:00 AEST) might explain the spike; review of DISPATCHPRICE pre‑AP and participant bid/offer data for that interval would test this.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Fetch DISPATCHPRICE pre_AP fields and participant bid/offer and rebid records for interval ending 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z (2026-08-06 13:00 AEST).

possible_explanations.statement: Export flow out of Tasmania (net interchange = 63.84 MW at the peak) might have coincided with local supply changes and could be related to local price pressure; check interconnector availability and constraint logs to test this.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Inspect Basslink/interconnector availability and constraint binding logs covering 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z (2026-08-06 13:00 AEST).

possible_explanations.statement: Observed SCADA decreases on some units and increases on others (for example MUSSELRO change +54.8 MW [ev1428] and LK_ECHO change −27.1 MW [ev1440]) might be associated with changing local supply; checking unit availability, bid changes and outage logs would test this.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare unit availability/offers and outage logs and rebid history for MUSSELRO and LK_ECHO around 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z (2026-08-06 13:00 AEST).
